content.summary_short: Learn the AeroVista Trail System — EOD Capsules, handoff packets, release boards, registry, docs, memory, and backlog — then produce an Agent Handoff Packet + EOD Capsule Stub.
content.summary_long: Agent Day 4 teaches durable handoffs. Byte covers why handoffs matter, the seven update surfaces, the ten-part Handoff Packet, EOD Capsule human + machine layers, state-update discipline, anti-duplication lines, confidentiality in handoffs, and the final handoff formula. Completion requires gate acknowledgment, segment pass, quiz, and Handoff Packet drill.
content.key_line: If the next agent cannot tell what happened, the work is not done.
content.start_here: Complete the Day 4 gate, listen or read all segments, pass the handoff check, then submit your Agent Handoff Packet + EOD Capsule Stub on a real or simulated task.

sections.title: Cold Open
paragraphs: Day 1: find the door. Day 2: find the source. Day 3: turn signal into action.
Day 4: the handoff is the work — not cleanup, not admin.
If the next agent cannot tell what happened, the work is not done.

sections.title: Why Handoffs Matter Here
paragraphs: Context decays fast across divisions, systems, docs, memory, and operators.
A good handoff answers what changed, where, why it matters, what was verified, what is unknown, what is blocked, what happens next, who owns it, and what not to repeat.

sections.title: The AeroVista Trail System
paragraphs: Seven surfaces: EOD Capsule, handoff, release board, registry, documentation, memory, backlog.
Not every update belongs everywhere. An unowned "we should" is a ghost.

sections.title: The Handoff Packet
paragraphs: Ten parts: title, current state, what changed, evidence, decisions, open questions, risks, next action, owner, do not repeat.
A good title lets the next operator find the thread. Do not blur state words.

sections.title: EOD Capsules: Daily Memory With Teeth
paragraphs: Human layer for plain language; machine layer for structured data.
"Worked on docs" is almost useless. Name what changed, what remains, and what risk appeared.

sections.title: Done Is Not Done Until State Is Updated
paragraphs: A task can be complete but operationally invisible.
Before calling work done: release board, registry, handoff, EOD, doc status, memory, backlog, owner, risk.

sections.title: Preventing Duplicate Work
paragraphs: Duplicate work looks productive but steals momentum.
Use anti-duplication lines: already checked, already decided, drafted not published, current authority is Y.

sections.title: Confidentiality in Handoffs
paragraphs: Summarize safely — do not paste contracts, credentials, private URLs, or client data into broad handoffs.
Route full sensitive detail only to authorized lanes.

sections.title: The Final Handoff Formula
paragraphs: I touched, changed, verified, decided, found conflicts, did not touch, still unknown, risk, next action, owner, update surfaces, do not repeat.
You need a bridge, not a novel.

sections.title: Closing
paragraphs: Day 1: find the door. Day 2: find the source. Day 3: turn signal into action. Day 4: leave the trail.
The next agent is your continuation. The handoff is the work.

day4_gate.title: Day 4 Gate — Handoff Discipline Commitment
items: I completed Agent Days 1–3 (or received equivalent briefing on doors, source-of-truth verification, and AVCC judgment).
I understand the handoff is part of the work — not optional cleanup after the "real" task.
I will use the AeroVista Trail System and put updates on the correct surface (EOD, handoff, release board, registry, docs, memory, backlog).
I will not call work done until operational state is updated where required.
I will protect confidential evidence in handoffs — summarize safely and route sensitive detail to authorized lanes only.

prove.title: Agent Handoff Packet + EOD Capsule Stub
prove.description: Complete the Handoff Packet drill on a real or simulated AeroVista task — demonstrate durable continuity, not a vague summary.

fields.label: 2. Current State (Planned / Drafted / Built / Live / Healthy / Released / Adopted / Blocked / Stale / Unknown) — explain why
3. I Touched — systems, documents, files, pages, releases, roles, or decisions
5. I Verified — label each: live check, registry, release board, documentation, handoff, EOD, memory, operator instruction, legal source, test result
6. I Decided — separate decisions from observations
7. I Did Not Touch — what you intentionally avoided changing
9. Conflicts Found — Source A vs Source B, likely authority, risk if unresolved (or "none")
11. Next Action — one next action only
13. Update Surfaces Needed — check all that apply: EOD, handoff, release board, registry, documentation, memory, backlog, git/release notes, legal review, none
14. Do Not Repeat — what the next agent should not redo
15. Final Handoff Note (10 sentences or fewer)

questions.explain: Lost context sends the next agent backward by days or weeks.

choices: Both a human layer and a machine-readable layer
questions.explain: Humans need plain language; automation needs structure.

questions.q: Which update belongs on the release board?
choices: A change in release state (active, blocked, released, adopted)
questions.explain: Release state changes are system signals, not diary entries.

questions.q: "Done is not done until state is updated" means:
choices: Operational surfaces reflect the real current state
questions.explain: Invisible completion causes the system to lie without intent.

questions.q: A strong "Do not repeat" line sounds like:
choices: "Drafted, not published — do not treat script as shipped audio"
questions.explain: Anti-duplication lines save hours of rework.

questions.q: Confidential evidence in a handoff should be:
choices: Used for decisions but summarized safely in broad handoffs
questions.explain: Continuity without exposure — route detail to authorized lanes.

lesson.objective: Leave durable handoffs using the Trail System, Handoff Packet structure, EOD Capsule discipline, and final handoff formula.
lesson.why_it_matters: Agents who skip handoffs create operational fog — solved work becomes recurring confusion.
lesson.apply: Complete gate, all segments, quiz, and Handoff Packet + EOD Capsule Stub on a real task.
